words: Audit after B-6c2c (stopped) and B-vsb3 (wrong target): the limiting cause was the orchestrator's brief, which read 'less bulky' as 'smaller than generated' and then asked for a reshape. Every paw build since B-kgav also changed the paw's shape while adding detail. Outcome: lift the shape work entirely: the generated paw is the shape authority (hold: outline and size within 1 mm), and detail is added only on top of it (clefts carved shallow, claws and dewclaws as separate objects).
